notes.title: 100% STEAM DECK
notes.content:
Hello light switch flipping players,

your beloved Light Switch Simulator has 100% Steam Deck compatibility!
I mean, at least we hope and Valve will verify this, or we will fix it until it has 100% Steam Deck compatibility (seriously, I will reach that and if it's the last thing Ill do!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214809/0fd19bc66f00e40828b92a74d49439cc2a91d528.png[/img]

Enjoy flipping the switch(es) on the go, or on your couch, on the beach.

Enjoy the flipping EVERYWHERE!

- The SpielmannSpiel Team
